scope: Original extracted E_00B7.MLT bank passed through native game-facing and multi-unit download, section configuration and G2 helpers with full retail RAM/CPU/FPU/MMIO equality. Independent all section allocation table and four real payload byte writes and both temporary object cleanup. Native load wrapper calls native size/read/close wrappers with native open dispatcher, backend open, filename checksum/comparison/lookup, handle initializer and error setter. Only device read/start/poll callbacks are hooked; hardware readiness modeled. Disc initialization and device internals remain unrecovered; no audio execution.
